company.name: Mastiṣka
company.shortDescription: Mastiṣka is a fabless semiconductor company building AI compute infrastructure and GPU-class accelerators.
company.description: Mastiṣka is a UAE-based fabless semiconductor company building AI compute infrastructure for datacentre-scale workloads. The company develops GPU-class accelerators based on an activity-aware execution model, in which compute execution aligns with runtime workload activity rather than with model size. Mastiṣka’s roadmap progresses from FPGA-based systems to custom GPU silicon for large-scale AI training and inference infrastructure.
